name: account_context_get
title: Read the studio working context
description: Reads the owner's optional studio-wide working context: one bounded paragraph of standing context that spans Projects (who the studio is, recurring audience, standing constraints). Owner-only: guests and non-owner members receive not-found, and the context is private to the owner. A confirmed Project working brief takes precedence over this context, and the person's explicit request takes precedence over both. The context is not Project direction; a Project working brief is confirmed separately through project_brief_set. Read-only; no media effect.

brief.description: The exact current confirmed context text; empty when none is confirmed.

revision.description: The current monotonic context revision (0 when none exists).
